profiles_slug_live_uq.name: profiles_slug_live_uq
profiles_slug_live_uq.where: "profiles"."slug" is not null and "profiles"."deleted_at" is null

media_image_dimensions_ck.name: media_image_dimensions_ck
media_image_dimensions_ck.value: "media"."mime_type" not like 'image/%' or ("media"."width" is not null and "media"."height" is not null)

challenges_trading_days_ck.name: challenges_trading_days_ck
challenges_trading_days_ck.value: "challenges"."max_trading_days" is null or "challenges"."min_trading_days" is null or "challenges"."max_trading_days" >= "challenges"."min_trading_days"

prop_firms_has_draft_idx.name: prop_firms_has_draft_idx
prop_firms_has_draft_idx.where: "prop_firms"."draft_payload" is not null and "prop_firms"."deleted_at" is null

prop_firms_founded_year_ck.name: prop_firms_founded_year_ck
prop_firms_founded_year_ck.value: "prop_firms"."founded_year" is null or ("prop_firms"."founded_year" between 1900 and extract(year from now())::int + 1)

rule_values_target_ck.name: rule_values_target_ck
rule_values_target_ck.value:
("rule_values"."scope" = 'firm' and "rule_values"."prop_firm_id" is not null and "rule_values"."challenge_id" is null)
          or ("rule_values"."scope" = 'challenge' and "rule_values"."challenge_id" is not null and "rule_values"."prop_firm_id" is null)

rule_values_one_value_ck.name: rule_values_one_value_ck
rule_values_one_value_ck.value: ("rule_values"."value_boolean" is not null)::int + ("rule_values"."value_numeric" is not null)::int + ("rule_values"."value_text" is not null)::int = 1

affiliate_links_campaign_uq.name: affiliate_links_campaign_uq
affiliate_links_campaign_uq.where: "affiliate_links"."campaign" is not null and "affiliate_links"."deleted_at" is null

affiliate_links_window_ck.name: affiliate_links_window_ck
affiliate_links_window_ck.value: "affiliate_links"."ends_at" is null or "affiliate_links"."starts_at" is null or "affiliate_links"."ends_at" > "affiliate_links"."starts_at"

offers_firm_code_uq.name: offers_firm_code_uq
offers_firm_code_uq.where: "offers"."code" is not null and "offers"."deleted_at" is null

offers_window_ck.name: offers_window_ck
offers_window_ck.value: "offers"."ends_at" is null or "offers"."starts_at" is null or "offers"."ends_at" > "offers"."starts_at"

audit_logs_actor_match_ck.name: audit_logs_actor_match_ck
audit_logs_actor_match_ck.value:
("audit_logs"."actor_type" = 'admin' and "audit_logs"."actor_admin_id" is not null)
          or ("audit_logs"."actor_type" = 'user' and "audit_logs"."actor_user_id" is not null)
          or ("audit_logs"."actor_type" = 'system' and "audit_logs"."actor_admin_id" is null and "audit_logs"."actor_user_id" is null)

seo_target_ck.name: seo_target_ck
seo_target_ck.value:
("seo_metadata"."entity_id" is not null and "seo_metadata"."route_path" is null)
          or ("seo_metadata"."entity_id" is null and "seo_metadata"."route_path" is not null)
